Web UI frontend for your scanner

for dir in /export/*/; do
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    current_owner=$(stat -c "%u:%g" "$dir")
    if [ "$current_owner" != "1000:1000" ]; then
      echo "Changing ownership of $dir from $current_owner to 1000:1000"
      chown 1000:1000 "$dir"
    else
      echo "Skipping $dir - already owned by 1000:1000"
    fi
  fi
done

if [ -d "/target" ]; then
  current_owner=$(stat -c "%u:%g" "/target")
  if [ "$current_owner" != "1000:1000" ]; then
    echo "Changing ownership of /target from $current_owner to 1000:1000"
    chown 1000:1000 "/target" ; touch "/target/backup.marker"
  else
    echo "Skipping /target - already owned by 1000:1000"
  fi
fi

mkdir -p /data/snapshots
export VAULT_TOKEN=$(vault write -format=json auth/approle/login role_id=$APPROLE_ROLE_ID secret_id=$APPROLE_SECRET_ID | awk -F'"' '/client_token/{print $4}')
vault operator raft snapshot save /data/snapshots/openbao-raft.snap
ls -l /data/snapshots

until [ -f /data/snapshots/openbao-raft.snap ]; do sleep 5; done
gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=/data/credentials/credentials.json
